sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: value is the JSON text produced by serialize.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A Snapshot with any serialized error restored to an Error object.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.
sections.code:
const snapshot = deserialize(element.textContent!);
const router = createDataRouter(routes, { hydrationData: snapshot });

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Use trusted snapshot text from your server. Invalid JSON throws; this function does not validate arbitrary input. Restored errors preserve their name and message without exposing server stack traces.
